description: This file defines the 'Information' controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles displaying information pages based on 'information_id', including setting page metadata and rendering views. It also provides an 'info' method for returning information data with specific headers.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for handling information pages, extending the base Controller class in Opencart's system engine.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering of an information page based on 'information_id' parameter. Loads language, model, sets document metadata, breadcrumb navigation, and renders the appropriate view.
methods.returns: On success, outputs the view; on failure, returns an Action object for not found.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides a brief info API that outputs the information title and description, adds a 'noindex' header to prevent search indexing.
